description: Validates scan.ps1 contains the $extMap hashtable with all 8 CodeQL-supported languages: javascript, python, java, csharp, cpp, go, ruby, swift. A missing language means files of that type will silently skip scanning.

command.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f = '${file}'; if ($f -notmatch 'scan\.ps1$') { exit 0 }; $c = Get-Content $f -Raw -ErrorAction Stop; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($c)) { Write-Host '[FAIL] scan.ps1 is empty:' $f; exit 2 }; if ($c -notmatch '\$extMap') { Write-Host '[FAIL] scan.ps1 missing $extMap hashtable in' $f; exit 2 }; $missing = @(); foreach ($lang in @('javascript','python','java','csharp','cpp','go','ruby','swift')) { if ($c -notmatch [regex]::Escape("'$lang'")) { $missing += $lang } }; if ($missing.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host '[FAIL] scan.ps1 $extMap missing language(s):' ($missing -join ', ') 'in' $f; exit 2 }; exit 0"
